# Tobu Tobu Girl

An arcade platformer for the Game Boy by Tangram Games (Simon Larsen and
others, 2017): http://tangramgames.dk/tobutobugirl,
https://github.com/SimonLarsen/tobutobugirl. Its code is under the MIT
licence (`LICENSE`), its art and music under CC BY 4.0
(https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/).

`tobutobugirl.gb` is the ROM as CAMLBOY's repository ships it
(`resource/games/tobu.gb`, https://github.com/linoscope/CAMLBOY),
unchanged.
It comes with MyNOS's camlboy package (`games/tobutobugirl.gb`): type
`camlboy tobutobugirl`.
